bibliographic.abstract: The synthesis of IrI3 at high pressure in its layered honeycomb polymorph is reported. Its crystal structure is refined by single crystal X-ray diffraction. Faults in the honeycomb layer stacking are observed by single crystal diffraction, synchrotron powder diffraction, and transmission electron microscopy. A previously unreported “hyperhoneycomb” polymorph of IrI3 (-IrI3), is also described - Its structure in space group F _ddd_ is determined by single crystal XRD. Both materials are highly-resistive diamagnetic semiconductors, consistent with a low spin _d_[6] configuration for Ir(III). The two- and three-dimensional Ir arrays in these polymorphs of IrI3 are analogous to those found in the _α-_ and _β-_ polymorphs of Li2IrO3, although the Ir electron configurations are different.

samples.sample_description: Monoclinic layered honeycomb structure IrI3 obtained by quench cooling from 700 or 800 °C.
samples.supplier_or_creator: prepared by a solid-state high pressure synthesis method from stoichiometric elemental iridium (Alfa Aesar 99.9%) and iodine (Alfa Aesar 99.99+%, resublimed for purification)

samples.sample_description: Orthorhombic IrI3 phase formed in high proportion by cooling at 50 °C/min from 800 °C, or either slowly cooling or quenching from 900 °C.
samples.supplier_or_creator: prepared by a solid-state high pressure synthesis method from stoichiometric elemental iridium (Alfa Aesar 99.9%) and iodine (Alfa Aesar 99.99+%, resublimed for purification)

datasets.dataset_description: SCXRD data collected on small crystals of α-IrI3 and β-IrI3 for crystal structure refinement.
Laboratory PXRD patterns collected and Le Bail fitted for α-IrI3 and β-IrI3 samples.
High-resolution synchrotron powder diffraction data acquired for α-IrI3 showing asymmetric peak shapes characteristic of stacking faults.
TEM imaging and atomic-resolution high-angle annular dark-field scanning transmission electron microscopy imaging performed to characterize stacking faults and atomic stacking in α-IrI3.
datasets.measurement_technique: Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) imaging and atomic-resolution high-angle annular dark-field scanning transmission electron microscopy imaging

datasets.dataset_description: Temperature-dependent Magnetization (M) data collected from 1.8 to 300 K under an applied field of 0.1 Tesla.
Field-dependent magnetization measurements of polycrystalline α-IrI3 powder from -9 T to 9 T at two different temperatures.
Resistivity measured from 260 to 300 K on an as-made dense piece of α-IrI3 and from 270 to 300 K on an as-made dense sample dominated by β-IrI3.
Diffuse reflectance data collected at ambient temperature on polycrystalline α- and β-IrI3-dominated samples and transferred to pseudo absorbance using Kubelka-Munk theory.
